function.name: _company_expert_list
function.description: Query team expert list with pagination and optional name, status, key, or id filters. Returns {list,count}.

pageSize.description: Number of records per page (optional, default 30).

name.description: Fuzzy match by expert name, optional.

key.description: Exact match by expert key, optional.

id.description: Exact match by expert ID, optional.
